query:
-- IDs dos clientes de teste
SELECT id FROM allowed_clients 
WHERE LOWER(name) LIKE '%teste%' OR LOWER(name) LIKE '%test%' 
   OR LOWER(email) LIKE '%teste%' OR LOWER(email) LIKE '%test%'
   OR LOWER(name) = 'new client';
